data.title: Greetings & Conversation — Starter · Lesson 10
data.subject: greetings
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
¡Dale! Let's go!

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
Let's roll… Vamos
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres
Time to learn, you and me.

[Verse]
Waking up, it's a brand new day,
Good morning… Buenos días, let's start this way.
Yes… sí, no… no, let's get it right,
Buen día, good day, shining bright.
Getting ready, putting on my shoes,
Encantado, nice to meet you, that's the news.
¿Que tal? How's it going? I ask with a grin,
¿Y tú? And you? Let's dive in.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
How are you?… ¿Cómo estás?
Let's roll… Vamos
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres
Time to learn, you and me.

[Verse]
Out the door, feeling alive,
Bien, fine, everything's gonna thrive.
Gracias, thank you, for the kindness you show,
Mucho gusto, pleased to meet you, let the friendship grow.
Walking down the street, feeling so free,
¿Como te llamas? What's your name? It's you and me.
Hola, hello, I wave to a friend,
De nada, you're welcome, let's do it again.

[Bridge]
In the classroom, voices ring,
